title: Transparency
lead: Everything that comes in and everything that goes out, with its date.
method: The totals are calculated by adding the records below. They are not typed in by hand: if the sum of the detail did not match the total, that would be an error, and there is an automatic test that catches it before each publication.
Gifts are recorded after they are reconciled against the bank statement. The date of the last reconciliation is published, because a number without a date is not a fact.

Individual gift amounts and the names of those who gave are not published. Expenses are, with an indication of whether they have a receipt. The receipt files can be reviewed by a person with an auditor role: they are not published because they often hold third-party data.
Nothing is deleted. If a record was entered in error, it is voided with the reason and the date, and it stops adding. The void stays on the record.
